cases.purpose: Check both associated options with relative, absolute, symlink and hard-link paths, multiple matching loops, unrelated loop, and an empty no-match listing, in the util-linux -j line format.
cases.oracle: Explicit replacement contract and independently attached guest loop devices.
cases.comparison: Assert status, empty stderr, the util-linux line format (device, bracketed backing device number, backing inode, canonical path; no header), exact loop device set and row count.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $(type -t losetup) == builtin ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$ ]] || exit 125
work=$PWD/assoc-work
/usr/bin/mkdir "$work" || exit 125
cd "$work" || exit 125
l1= l2= l3=
cleanup() { for d in "$l1" "$l2" "$l3"; do [[ -z $d ]] || /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$d" || return 1; done; }
trap 'cleanup' EXIT
/usr/bin/truncate -s 65536 a b c || exit 125
/usr/bin/ln -s a sym && /usr/bin/ln a hard || exit 125
l1=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show a) || exit 125
l2=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show a) || exit 125
l3=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show b) || exit 125
[[ -n $l1 && -n $l2 && -n $l3 && $l1 != "$l2" && $l1 != "$l3" && $l2 != "$l3" ]] || exit 125
for d in "$l1" "$l2" "$l3"; do [[ -s /sys/block/${d#/dev/}/loop/backing_file ]] || exit 125; done
expected_a=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$l1" "$l2" | /usr/bin/sort)
ia=$(/usr/bin/stat -c %i a) && ib=$(/usr/bin/stat -c %i b) || exit 125
# util-linux -j/--associated: one "DEV: [BACKING-DEVNO]:INODE (PATH)" line per
# matching loop, no header, nothing at all when no loop matches.
check() {
    local option=$1 path=$2 expected=$3 ino=$4 base=$5 rc rows
    losetup "$option" "$path" >out 2>err; rc=$?
    [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s err ]] || return 1
    if [[ -s out ]]; then
        /usr/bin/grep -Evq '^/dev/loop[0-9]+: \[[0-9]{4,}\]:'"$ino"' \(/.*/'"$base"'\)$' out && return 1
    fi
    rows=$(/usr/bin/awk -F': ' '{print $1}' out | /usr/bin/sort)
    [[ $rows == "$expected" ]] || return 1
    [[ $(/usr/bin/wc -l <out) == $(printf '%s' "$expected" | /usr/bin/awk 'NF {n++} END {print n+0}') ]] || return 1
}
for opt in -j --associated; do
    for path in a "$work/a" sym hard; do check "$opt" "$path" "$expected_a" "$ia" a || exit 1; done
    check "$opt" b "$l3" "$ib" b || exit 1
    check "$opt" c '' - - || exit 1
    check "$opt" missing '' - - || exit 1
done
cleanup || exit 1
trap - EXIT
printf 'associated contract ok\n'
